method: every figure below is measured from the emitted centreline samples, not copied from the design document

closureError.note: straight lengths in the canopy and Fuel Row were solved for closure; loop closes analytically and the residual is floating point only

sampleCount.note: spacing is L/N so the last sample joins the first exactly

selfIntersection.method: pairwise planar distance between all sample pairs more than 80 m apart along the centreline

sectorLengthDeltas.note: the closure solve moved straight lengths only — every published radius, width, banking and checkpoint anchor is unchanged

speedTargets.history: the document previously read 115-130 m/s against a 70-80 s lap, which was a unit error; the lap-time target was moved rather than the corner-entry figure
speedTargets.openRisk: at a 400 km/h peak, T10's 300 m readable approach is about 2.7 s of sight time and the Elbow's 175 m is about 1.6 s. Both are now the first thing the in-engine test has to confirm.
